login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your tomato farm workspace.
login.errorDeactivated: This account has been deactivated. Contact your administrator.
login.errorServiceNotConfigured: Backend service is not configured — set VITE_BACKEND_API_URL in your .env file.

signup.title: Register farmer account
signup.subtitle: New users create an account before entering the dashboard.
signup.locationDenied: Location access denied. You can still sign up — add your location later from your Profile page to enable weather data.
signup.terms: I agree to the project platform terms and privacy notice.
signup.errorPasswordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters.
signup.errorEmailExists: An account with this email already exists. Please sign in.
signup.errorServiceNotConfigured: Backend service is not configured — set VITE_BACKEND_API_URL in your .env file.

dashboard.sub: Here is the latest snapshot of your farm’s health.
dashboard.getStarted: Complete a disease scan or soil analysis to get started.
dashboard.noScanYet: No scan yet. Take a photo to check for disease.
dashboard.noSoilYet: No analysis yet. Upload a report or check soil.
dashboard.noWeatherYet: No data. Fetch current conditions for your farm.
dashboard.backendNotConfigured: Backend not configured — set VITE_BACKEND_API_URL in .env

profile.title: Farmer & Tomato Farm Profile
profile.sub: Update your personal information and farm coordinates for accurate weather data.
profile.coordinatesHint: Your live weather relies on these GPS coordinates.
profile.locationNotFound: Could not find coordinates for that location.
profile.errorPasswordLength: New password must be at least 6 characters.

disease.title: Leaf Disease Analysis
disease.sub: Upload a clear tomato leaf image. The result is uploaded to secure storage and saved to your history.
disease.uploadPrompt: Upload a leaf image to receive the disease detection result.
disease.lowConfidence: Low confidence detected. For a more accurate result, please retake the photo in bright, natural daylight with the leaf filling the frame and in sharp focus.
disease.noScansYet: No scans yet — your completed analyses will appear here.
disease.noImageAvailable: No image available for this scan
disease.errorInvalidFile: Please choose a valid image file (JPG, PNG or WEBP).
disease.errorFileTooLarge: Please choose an image smaller than 8 MB.
disease.errorNotLeaf: We could not identify a suitable leaf image. Please upload a clear tomato leaf photo.
disease.errorUnreadable: This image could not be read. Please try another image.

soil.title: Soil Analysis
soil.subLatest: Your latest soil analysis result. Run a new analysis at any time.
soil.subNew: Upload a soil-test report image for server-side OCR, or answer the questionnaire for a quick rule-based assessment.
soil.ocrHint: OCR extracted these values. Correct any errors before confirming.
soil.runNewSub: Upload a new report image or fill out the questionnaire.
soil.questionnaireSub: Answer the six questions — no lab test needed. Nutrient readings will be null in the saved row.
soil.ocrUploadSuccess: Report uploaded and OCR complete. Review the values below, correct any errors, then confirm.
soil.errorInvalidFile: Only JPG, PNG, or WEBP files are accepted.

weather.title: Weather
weather.sub: Live conditions fetched from Open-Meteo for your farm’s GPS location.
weather.noLocationHint: Weather data requires your farm’s GPS coordinates. Go to your Profile page to add latitude and longitude, then come back here.

recommendations.title: Crop Recommendations
recommendations.sub: Generated fresh from your latest scan, soil analysis, and weather data.
recommendations.noDataSub: Recommendations are generated from your latest disease scan, soil analysis, and weather check. Complete at least one of these to get started.
recommendations.healthUnavailable: Health status unavailable — complete a disease scan and soil analysis to enable this.
recommendations.noDiseaseScan: No disease scan on record yet. Run a scan to get treatment advice.
recommendations.noSoilForFertilizer: No soil analysis on record yet. Run a soil test to get fertilizer advice.
recommendations.noSoilForIrrigation: No soil analysis on record yet. Run a soil test to get irrigation advice.
recommendations.dataUsedSub: Raw source figures — exactly what the computation read. Not modified or interpolated.
recommendations.footer: Recommendations are generated on-demand from your latest data and are not stored. Refresh this page to update.

history.title: History
history.sub: View your past disease scans, soil analyses, and weather records.
history.noRecordsSub: Try adjusting your filters, or run a new scan, soil test, or weather check to generate history.
